PowerShell($base = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('COLOSSEUM_COPILOT_API_BASE','User'\); $pat = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('COLOSSEUM_COPILOT_PAT','User'\); $h = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $pat"; "Content-Type" = "application/json" }; $targets = @\("v1-c16","v1-c27","v1-c6","v1-c26","v1-c14","v1-c28"\); foreach \($key in $targets\) { Write-Output "===== CLUSTER $key ====="; $c = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/clusters/$key" -Headers $h -TimeoutSec 12; "Label: $\($c.label\) | $\($c.projectCount\) projects | $\($c.winnerCount\) winners"; "Summary: $\($c.summary\)"; Write-Output "Top problems:"; $c.topTags.problemTags | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { "  - $\($_.tag\) \($\($_.count\)\)" }; Write-Output "Reps:"; $c.representativeProjects | Select-Object -First 6 | ForEach-Object { "  $\(if\($_.isWinner\){'W'}else{'.'}\) $\($_.name\) — $\($_.oneLiner\)" }; Write-Output "" })

PowerShell($base = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('COLOSSEUM_COPILOT_API_BASE','User'\); $pat = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('COLOSSEUM_COPILOT_PAT','User'\); $h = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $pat"; "Content-Type" = "application/json" }; $queries = @\( "winning hackathon Solana criteria", "what makes hackathon winner Colosseum", "Solana accelerator selection criteria", "hackathon judging Anatoly Yakovenko" \); foreach \($q in $queries\) { Write-Output ""; Write-Output "===== ARCHIVE: $q ====="; $body = @{ query = $q; limit = 4; intent = "ideation" } | ConvertTo-Json; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/search/archives" -Method Post -Headers $h -Body $body -TimeoutSec 15; $r.results | Select-Object -First 4 | ForEach-Object { "  [$\($_.source\)] $\($_.title\) | $\($_.publishedDate\)"; "      $\($_.snippet\)" } } catch { Write-Output "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($base = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('COLOSSEUM_COPILOT_API_BASE','User'\); $pat = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('COLOSSEUM_COPILOT_PAT','User'\); $h = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $pat"; "Content-Type" = "application/json" }; $key_winners = @\("capitola","unruggable","yumi-finance","seer","mcpay","attn.markets","samui-wallet","reflect","pregame","fxswap","supersize","squeeze","alphafc","txtx","trenches.top","wink","melee-markets","trepa","verve","marshmallow"\); foreach \($slug in $key_winners\) { try { $p = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/projects/by-slug/$slug" -Headers $h -TimeoutSec 10; "  $\($p.name\) | $\($p.hackathon.name\) | prize=$\($p.prize.amount\) | team=$\($p.team.count\) | techStack=$\(\($p.tags.techStack\) -join ','\)" } catch { Write-Output "  $slug : not found" } })

PowerShell($base = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('COLOSSEUM_COPILOT_API_BASE','User'\); $pat = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('COLOSSEUM_COPILOT_PAT','User'\); $h = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $pat"; "Content-Type" = "application/json" }; $winners = @\("project-plutus","flowfi-pay","snapsolpay","stableyard","crosspay","solagent"\); foreach \($slug in $winners\) { Write-Output "===== $slug ====="; try { $p = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/projects/by-slug/$slug" -Headers $h -TimeoutSec 10; @{ name = $p.name; oneLiner = $p.oneLiner; hackathon = $p.hackathon.name; prize = if\($p.prize\){"WIN $\($p.prize.amount\)"}else{"no"}; team = $p.team.count; problems = \($p.tags.problemTags\) -join " | "; solutions = \($p.tags.solutionTags\) -join " | "; primitives = \($p.tags.primitives\) -join " | " } | ConvertTo-Json } catch { Write-Output "  not found: $slug" } })

PowerShell($base = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('COLOSSEUM_COPILOT_API_BASE','User'\); $pat = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('COLOSSEUM_COPILOT_PAT','User'\); $h = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $pat"; "Content-Type" = "application/json" }; $slugs = @\("trepa","melee-markets","urani"\); foreach \($slug in $slugs\) { Write-Output ""; Write-Output "===== $slug ====="; try { $p = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/projects/by-slug/$slug" -Headers $h -TimeoutSec 12; "Name: $\($p.name\)"; "OneLiner: $\($p.oneLiner\)"; "Hackathon: $\($p.hackathon.name\)"; "Prize: $\($p.prize.name\) `$$\($p.prize.amount\)"; "Team: $\($p.team.count\)"; "---LINKS---"; "GitHub:        $\($p.links.github\)"; "Demo:          $\($p.links.demo\)"; "Presentation:  $\($p.links.presentation\)"; "Technical Demo: $\($p.links.technicalDemo\)"; "Twitter:       $\($p.links.twitter\)"; "Colosseum:     $\($p.links.colosseum\)"; "Website:       $\($p.links.website\)" } catch { Write-Output "ERR: $_" } })
